REDSCORE · PRACTICAL PREPAREDNESS

Power outage: prepare light, information and supplies

During a longer power outage, lighting, heating, refrigeration and communications may be affected. A few prepared items can make everyday life easier.

Updated: 7 October 2026 · RedScore editorial team

Light and communication

Keep a torch, compatible spare batteries and charged power banks ready. A battery-powered or hand-crank radio can help you follow official information. Keep important contacts on paper too.

Warmth and food

Plan warm clothing, blankets, water and long-lasting food that does not need electric cooking. Cash may help when ATMs are unavailable.

Act safely

Never use a barbecue or generator in living spaces: carbon monoxide can cause poisoning. Follow instructions from authorities and your electricity provider.

Choose the next small step

RedScore combines your preparedness check with your recorded supplies. Begin with one open task: check lighting, record water or add to your packing list. Your score is based on your entries and is not an official certification.
